coder_notes: Temozolomide is not a registered intervention but the arm text states every patient receives the Stupp regimen, so it is listed as soc_backbone (R9). Active moiety given as 'niacin' (record also names nicotinic acid); script will normalise. Niacin CRT is described as a controlled release tablet; record does not say it is a new formulation, so formulation_flag = none. No antitumour mechanism is stated; the PD measure is effect on peripheral monocytes/innate immune cells (blood), coded target engagement yes. Peripheral monocyte activity is not a tumour molecular biomarker, so not listed. IDH-wildtype defines GBM only.
